instruments.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Management system

facet_hints.nature: 42001 is a management-system standard: it asks for governance artifacts, not code properties. Map it to the presence and quality of documentation, roles, risk assessment and lifecycle controls rather than to lines of code.
facet_hints.ai_impact_assessment: Annex controls include AI system impact assessment, data governance for AI, and lifecycle management.
facet_hints.note: The standard text is copyrighted and not freely retrievable; cite the ISO catalogue entry and any freely published summaries, and do not fabricate clause text.

seed_obligations.title: Maintain an AI policy with assigned responsibilities
Assess the impact of the AI system on individuals and groups
applies_when: deploys an AI system affecting people

seed_obligations.title: Govern the data used to develop and operate the AI system
applies_when: trains, tunes, or grounds a model on data
testable_as: documented provenance of training and grounding data
a decision on whether personal data may be used
controls against personal data entering prompts and logs
